title: Year 11 Investigating Science Module 1 – Cause and Effect – Observing
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Investigating Science Module 1. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What is information gathered directly using the senses or measuring instruments called?
What term describes an explanation or interpretation made from observations?
What usually comes first in a scientific investigation: observation or conclusion?
What type of question can be investigated using observations or measurements?
What tentative, testable explanation predicts a relationship between variables?
Data describing colour, texture or smell are what type of data?
Data recorded as numbers and measurements are what type of data?
“The solution is blue” is what type of observation?
“The temperature is 24 °C” is what type of observation?
Which type of data is usually easier to compare statistically: qualitative or quantitative?
What variable is deliberately changed by the investigator?
What variable is measured or observed as the outcome?
What variables are kept the same to make a fair test?
A hypothesis should link which two main variables?
Keeping other factors constant mainly improves what aspect of an investigation?
What is data collected first-hand by the investigator called?
What is data obtained from sources collected by other people called?
Repeating measurements helps improve what quality of data?
What term describes how close a measurement is to the true or accepted value?
What term describes how close repeated measurements are to one another?
Which scientist is linked to observations of water displacement while bathing?
Which scientist observed mould inhibiting bacterial growth, leading to penicillin research?
What should be included with a numerical measurement so its meaning is clear?
What simple data display uses separate rectangular bars to compare categories?
questions.answer: A bar graph. Accept: bar chart.

questions.prompt: What graph is commonly used to show the relationship between two continuous numerical variables?
questions.answer: A scatter plot. Accept: scatter graph.

finalRound.prompt: What term describes a conclusion or explanation drawn from observations rather than directly observed itself?
